messages:
alex: Quick follow-up after the postmortem — we have recurring KV-cache stalls causing generation p95 spikes. Need concrete owners for: (A) scoped SLO proposal, (B) dashboard slices + recurrence alert, (C) runtime throttling + batching rollback plan.

nina: I can draft the scoped-SLO text. Thinking of "tiered SLOs": default p95=150ms, large-context tier p95=250ms (ctx>2k or tokens>4k). Will include measurement queries showing breakouts. ETA 48h.

richard: I'll take runtime mitigations: adaptive throttle (inflight queue + kv-hit signal) + a rollback flag for batching defaults. Plan: repro in staging today, design doc + PR in 4 business days.

alex: Dashboard owner? We want per-model, per-route tail latency, rolling burn-rate, and an alert that clusters postmortem tags and fires if same root_cause appears 3 times in 90d.

nina: I can own the SLO ticket & governance routing. I'll attach queries: `rate(requests{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))` and explain why we need the tiered carve-out.

richard: For the throttle: initial heuristic = `if kv_hit_ratio < 0.6 && inflight_queue > 200 then preferentially shed long-context requests else allow`. Will add a soft-degrade path instead of hard drop. Prototype today, PR by EOW.

alex: I prefer not to reset the error budget — it's a real burn that helps prioritize infra work. If governance insists, we can add a temporary exception window annotated in SLO docs. Thoughts?

nina: Agree no-reset. I'll document an exception window in the SLO ticket to avoid confusion while we roll mitigations. Also proposing weekly SLO governance review for the next 4 weeks.

richard: Dash/alerts: I'll add minimal panels to staging Grafana: per-route p50/p95/p99, QPS, kv-hit ratio, and a burn-rate heatmap. For recurrence detection, suggest a lightweight clusterer that groups postmortem tags by root_cause and increments a counter. If counter >=3 within 90d, fire PagerDuty alert.

alex: sounds good. Nina, tag product & reliability in the SLO ticket. Richard, add the clusterer design in the dash ticket so we can test.

pagerbot: Reminder set for 2026-04-05 10:30 UTC to review owners: nina, richard, alex.

nina: Created SLO ticket SLO-2026-561 with measurement queries, tiered SLO proposal, and a request for product sign-off. Asking for review within 48h.

richard: Dash ticket D-9901 created; added panels and a simulated recurrence test that increments the cluster counter. Will promote to prod after SLO sign-off.

alex: Batching note: we'll run an A/B: 1% -> 10% canary for batching default changes. If throttle + dash reduce tail, we'll promote. I'll coordinate canary windows with infra.

nina: Scheduling a 2-week follow-up to validate recurrence suppression and confirm SLO adjustments. Also adding a policy note: keep budgets unreset unless governance approves a reset with explicit reasons.

richard: PR-5491 (draft) for adaptive throttle posted; includes staging repro steps and trace links: http://go/trace/INC-2026-442. Feedback welcome.

alex: Recap of owners/dates: nina (SLO ticket + governance) - 48h, richard (throttle + PR) - EOW, alex (batching canary coordination + runbook) - +3d, dash (richard) - 48h. No error budget reset. 2-week review scheduled. Closing thread, update respective tickets and ping here for blockers. Thanks :thumbsup:
